items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-04-23
items.q: Dave Atholomew had already told me, said, man, well look up, we gonna do like, and it's his words, we gonna do like Arthur Prysock and Buddy Johnson with Arthur Prysock... So this is what Dave said, it was gonna do with me.

ctx.x: Yeah. And your big song with Dekka was Tra La La.

Okay, yeah, well that's something to talk about. Was Tra La La story? Okay, I wrote Tra La La. I never forget how I wrote it. I wrote Tra La La. See, because it was that Lord of Miss Claude kind of progression again. Laying across my bed, I'm living on Andover Street. That's how I wrote the song. And I had a little piano out on a porch that used to cut down bang on. Well then I wrote that song there and I had this song and I told it to everybody. So we finally got around to recording. Never did have a flip side…
Now my record came out doing fantastic.
